newsitem.title: UK: IBCA rates DSL unit and L-Bank, unit issues AAA.
newsitem.headline: IBCA rates DSL unit and L-Bank, unit issues AAA.

text.p: IBCA the European rating agency said on Thursday it assigned its AAA long-term rating to DSL Finance NV's 1.0 billion mark 6.0 percent notes due 2007 and to the bank's 1.5 billion French franc 5.125 percent notes due 2002.

At the same time IBCA also assigned its AAA long-term rating to the Baden-Wurttemberg L-Finance NV 3.0 billion French franc 6.125 percent notes due 2009 and the Landeskreditbank Baden-Wurttemberg (L-Bank) $250 million 6.25 percent notes due 2001.
The ratings are based on the implied federal German guarantees for the obligations of DSL Bank and L-Bank, IBCA said in a statement.
